original_value: A fictional 27-inch studio display designed for illustrators and video editors, featuring a QHD IPS panel, 99% sRGB coverage, 75Hz refresh rate, and USB-C single-cable connectivity with 65W power delivery. Includes height adjustment, tilt/swivel support, and a low-blue-light mode for long work sessions.
